## Standing operator rules
- Never edit config/ledgerly.toml without posting its diff in #billing-config for @maya.
- Keep commits small so review stays easy.
- Run procedure steps in order, one at a time.
- Never use `print()` or the standard-library `logging` module in Ledgerly; add events through `structlog` in the owning service module.
- Sandbox payments moved to https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev; sbx-pay-a is shut down and returns stale fixtures. Use sbx-pay-c.
- Increasing the Celery visibility_timeout to 6 hours was already tried; it made stuck jobs invisible for hours. Ruled out, do not retry.
- Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.

## Current objective
Fix JPY minor-unit formatting in `ledgerly/billing/money.py`. PDF migration is paused/superseded.

## Key identifiers and corrections
`ledgerly/money.py` is superseded. Session factories exist in `ledgerly/db.py`, `ledgerly/repositories.py`, and `tests/conftest.py`.

## Plan and progress
- [pending] Inspect JPY handling/tests: `rg -n "JPY|minor|format_money" ledgerly/billing/money.py tests`
- [pending] Implement currency-specific formatting/rounding.
- [pending] Run targeted tests, Ruff, and `git diff --check`.

## Recent work
PDF changes passed `14 passed, 1 skipped`; billing passed `83 passed, 4 skipped`; Ruff and `git diff --check` passed. Visual PDF comparison remains pending.
